openQuestions.question: Live feature-flag values, ingress header rewriting, upstream request-body limits, deployed migration state, and GitHub branch/environment protections were not established by repository source.
Findings describe the registered repository snapshot; production exposure depends on the corresponding code and migrations being deployed.

surfaces.label: Supabase identity, memberships, RLS, RPC grants, and role hierarchy
surfaces.notes: Version-binding report flaw validated; broader RLS/grant review found no cross-tenant table bypass.

surfaces.label: Admin and editor browser portals
surfaces.notes: Role checks and server-side authority were reviewed; no independent portal authorization bypass established.

surfaces.label: Gallery owner portal and publishing workflow
surfaces.notes: Owner draft Storage authorization and AI provider-spend controls are reportable.

surfaces.label: Public Eleventy site and Vercel route renderer
surfaces.notes: Stored XSS and unbounded route-event integrity issues validated.

surfaces.label: Supabase Edge Functions and external providers
surfaces.notes: Ranking integrity, RSVP/promotion allocation, AI spend, and page-load integrity issues validated.

surfaces.label: Android, iOS, and shared Kotlin mobile clients
surfaces.notes: OAuth fixation, account-switch cache, push cleanup, and avatar allocation issues validated.
surfaces.riskArea: Mobile sessions and local account separation

surfaces.label: CI, production cutover, release, and operator tooling
Repository credentials and public/private configuration
surfaces.notes: No embedded private credential or key was established; public client identifiers and synthetic fixtures were distinguished.

candidate.title: Public Edge handlers buffer bodies before enforcing byte limits

surfaces.label: Public Edge request-body pre-buffering candidate
surfaces.notes: Handlers materialize bodies before local byte checks, but repository source does not establish the upstream runtime cap or a concrete availability threshold; retained as hardening, not a finding.

candidate.title: Legacy archive and restore trust replaceable host executables

surfaces.label: Legacy archive/restore local toolchain candidate
surfaces.notes: Replaceable operator-owned executables are visible, but no attacker boundary or incremental capability beyond same-user local code execution was established.

candidate.title: Gallery upload trusts a self-asserted bundle manifest hash

surfaces.label: Gallery profile bundle approval-binding candidate
surfaces.notes: The bundle is weakly bound to the reviewed manifest, but source does not establish an attacker who can replace the operator-selected local bundle without equivalent operator compromise.

candidate.title: CI release and production-source checks rely on incomplete repository identity or approval binding

surfaces.label: CI release and production-source policy candidate
surfaces.notes: Repository workflows omit some explicit gates, but deployed collaborator roles, branch protection, protected environments, and required-status configuration are unavailable, so a concrete unauthorized release or merge path was not established.
